Charges as recorded: New York state conspiracy (156 counts) - charged with the other 20 defendants in the Panther 21 indictment of April 2, 1969 for an alleged plot to bomb NYPD precincts, the Bronx Botanical Garden, midtown department stores, and a railroad right-of-way. The prosecution case rested almost entirely on the testimony of three undercover NYPD officers; the jury deliberated approximately 90 minutes and acquitted all 13 defendants who went to trial of every count.
